proof_scope: Regression guard for system Chrome external-page commits through Surf: socket presence is insufficient if normal HTTPS tabs never commit or content scripts never load.

claims.proves: Surf can create a normal external HTTPS tab in the active Chrome profile, observe its committed URL through tab.list, and read page text through the content-script path.
claims.does_not_prove: Authenticated provider success, ChatGPT account state, WebGPT semantic quality, or Chrome package health outside this workstation.

capability_claims.description: Surf does not treat a live native socket as sufficient browser readiness; a normal external page must commit and become readable.

cases.name: chrome-external-page-commits-and-content-script-loads
command:
set -euo pipefail
cd ..
OUT=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/surf-external-page-commit
rm -rf "$OUT"; mkdir -p "$OUT"
./run.sh tab.new https://example.com --json | tee "$OUT/tab-new.txt"
TAB=$(grep -oE 'tab [0-9]+' "$OUT/tab-new.txt" | awk '{print $2}' | tail -1)
if [ -z "$TAB" ]; then echo NO_TAB_ID; exit 20; fi
sleep 20
./run.sh tab.list --json | tee "$OUT/tab-list.json"
python3 - "$OUT/tab-list.json" "$TAB" <<'PY'
import json, sys
tabs=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); tab=next((t for t in tabs if str(t.get('id'))==sys.argv[2]), None)
if not tab:
    raise SystemExit('TAB_MISSING')
url=tab.get('url') or ''
if not url.startswith('https://example.com'):
    raise SystemExit(f'TAB_URL_NOT_COMMITTED:{url!r}')
PY
./run.sh text --tab-id "$TAB" | tee "$OUT/text.txt"
grep -q 'Example Domain' "$OUT/text.txt"
echo EXTERNAL_PAGE_COMMIT_OK

stderr_contains: Socket connect failed: Socket not found
